review_description: I purchased Trina panels and Emphase micro inverters from GBES and they were very professional in their advise and installation.
Found every one, including installers, very helpful and informative. Only took approx 4 hours from time installers arrived till my new system was punching power back into the grid.

I have known the installer for a number of years.He is not a major  player in the market so handles everything personally - no sales staff. I found some sales people quoted on what they thought could be done rather than what could actually be done.Although he does not give a credit  for the STC's off the initial price I get the full $40-back via the Clearing House which he handles on my behalf.Although I understand this will take time it made the price very competitive.The whole experience was hassle free and I have recommended him to others.Thank you for supplying so much information that made my decision much easier.
